title: 'Iran and Hezbollah still able to coordinate strikes on Israel'
summary: Iran continues to strike Israel, with several missiles managing to pass through the country's air defences. More than a million people are in bomb shelters, while six people were injured in multiple sites in Tel Aviv. This shows 'Hezbollah and Iran are still able to coordinate strikes', says FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky from Jerusalem.
